citation.authors: Lane JE, Waller JL, Davis LS

record.population: 32 patients with keloids resulting from ear piercing
record.design: Survey of consecutive patients, Fisher's exact test
record.finding: Of those who had piercings at age 11 or older, 80% developed keloids against 23.5% of those pierced before 11. Half developed a keloid after their first piercing. The authors advise people with a family history to consider avoiding ear piercing.
record.note: Only people who already had keloids were surveyed, so it cannot give the risk of piercing; it compares age among those affected. Tiny sample.
